RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this. _Available since v3.1._

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

lifecycleEvidence.primaryDocumentation: > For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://docs.sandclock.org/current/llms.txt). Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://docs.sandclock.org/current/quartz-and-the-dao/staking.md). # Staking ## **sQUARTZ** & Multiplier Points Deposit Quartz for sQuartz and over time claim performance fees from Sandclock yield strategies. Additionally receive bonus multiplier points (inspired by [GMX reward mechanism](https://gmxio.gitbook.io/gmx/rewards)) at 100% APR which can be compounded in order to claim a bigger portion of the staking rewards. ## Time-decaying Tax & Unstaking Tax We all know taxes impede the free market but they can have their uses. This mechanism, heavily inspired by Will Comyns and the IRS, aims to encourage long term holding at the expense of short term holders, similar to how long term capital gains incur a lower tax rate, and short term capital gains count as ordinary income. To accomplish the goals outlined above, redeeming sQUARTZ for QUARTZ will incur a **tax penalty**, with the goal of rewarding long term holders, and dampening volatility during market sell-offs. This tax starts at its **maximum** and **decays over time** until it reaches \~0%. {% hint style="info" %} The tax will start at 10% and will **fall linearly** to 0% over the span of **30 days**. {% endhint %} Analyzing the behavior of a staker, one will unstake when revenue has fallen. The share of taxed tokens that are redistributed to those who remained staked increases their share and reduces their loss, while simultaneously decreasing the amount of tokens that get sold on the open market. At the same time, the remaining proportion of non-distributed tokens return to the treasury to be reinvested by the DAO. **How they are reinvested will be determined by the DAO.** ## Multiplier Points Multiplier Points rewards long term holders without inflation. When you stake QUARTZ, you receive Multiplier Points every second at a fixed rate of 100% APR. {% hint style="info" %} 10 QUARTZ staked for a year would earn you 10 Multiplier Points. {% endhint %} ## Rewards wETH rewards will be distribute to the QUARTZ stakers.
lifecycleEvidence.assessment: Current official application contains explicit QUARTZ staking route/configuration and current official docs describe deposit, unstaking tax, multiplier points and WETH rewards. No protocol-wide shutdown/retirement notice identified. Legacy yield vault visibility is not used as proof of this staking surface lifecycle.

selectedFunctions.label: Compound earned multiplier points
warnings: Accrues only caller reward/bonus accounting, moves earned bonus into caller multiplier points, and increases bonus-weighted reward share. No principal or reward-token transfer; points are proportionally burned on exit and are not fungible tokens.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Claim earned WETH rewards
warnings: The address identifies BOTH the reward-account owner and recipient. Anyone may trigger its accrued WETH payout but cannot redirect another account's rewards. Sets earned balance to zero and transfers fixed rewardToken; zero reward is a no-op.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Stake QUARTZ
warnings: QUARTZ staking uses 18-decimal QUARTZ, not a general yield vault. Each deposit creates debt initially equal to 10% of assets, decaying over 30 days; while debt remains, further deposits and normal withdrawals are blocked unless payDebt is used. Exits burn proportional multiplier points. Receiver MUST equal caller; pulls caller QUARTZ using pre-existing approval and mints sQUARTZ. No native value or permit.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Mint sQUARTZ
warnings: QUARTZ staking uses 18-decimal QUARTZ, not a general yield vault. Each deposit creates debt initially equal to 10% of assets, decaying over 30 days; while debt remains, further deposits and normal withdrawals are blocked unless payDebt is used. Exits burn proportional multiplier points. Receiver MUST equal caller; pulls the rounded-up QUARTZ amount required for shares using existing approval. totalAssets equals totalSupply, so shares are nominal staking principal rather than auto-compounding reward claims.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Pay early-exit staking tax
warnings: QUARTZ staking uses 18-decimal QUARTZ, not a general yield vault. Each deposit creates debt initially equal to 10% of assets, decaying over 30 days; while debt remains, further deposits and normal withdrawals are blocked unless payDebt is used. Exits burn proportional multiplier points. Pays ALL caller remaining time-decayed debt by withdrawing and burning the caller's corresponding staking principal to the mutable treasury, not by pulling extra wallet tokens. Not an unstake of all remaining principal; an additional withdrawal may be needed.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Redeem sQUARTZ
warnings: QUARTZ staking uses 18-decimal QUARTZ, not a general yield vault. Each deposit creates debt initially equal to 10% of assets, decaying over 30 days; while debt remains, further deposits and normal withdrawals are blocked unless payDebt is used. Exits burn proportional multiplier points. Redeems shares for QUARTZ rounded down; zero assets reverts. Non-owner caller needs existing share allowance. Reward claims remain separate.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Start funded WETH reward distribution
warnings: Public fixed reward-accounting transition: distributes only excess WETH already held by this fixed staking contract over its recorded reward balance, recomputing rate and period with leftover rewards. Does not pull caller funds, select token/recipient, or grant distributor role; unchanged balance is a no-op. No new prefunding helper is admitted.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Withdraw QUARTZ
warnings: QUARTZ staking uses 18-decimal QUARTZ, not a general yield vault. Each deposit creates debt initially equal to 10% of assets, decaying over 30 days; while debt remains, further deposits and normal withdrawals are blocked unless payDebt is used. Exits burn proportional multiplier points. Burns shares for the requested QUARTZ assets and pays receiver. Caller other than owner needs pre-existing share allowance. Rewards are accrued for owner but not automatically paid. No new allowance is created.
Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.

limitations: Static source/ABI admission only: no API-key grant, runtime attestation, funded execution, liquidity, backing, yield, safety or complete-workflow assurance.
Own Ethereum QUARTZ staking only, not the homepage-hidden legacy scETH/scUSDC/scLUSD wealth vaults or unsupported Swellchain loop products.
Direct source exact runtime match at observation; admin can change treasury and fee-source vault allowlist. Reward availability and sustainable revenue are not proved.
30-day initially 10% debt/tax gates new deposits and normal withdrawals; payDebt burns principal to treasury. Nominal staking shares, bonus multipliers and WETH rewards are distinct accounting units.
Only existing-share allowance permits delegated exits; no approval or permit grants selected. All selected methods are nonpayable.
Public startRewardsDistribution accounts only already-present reward surplus and may reset distribution timing; it does not supply a raw-prefund public-mint workaround or reward guarantee.
